upcoming.name: Radiance Motoha
upcoming.review:
Released for the P5X 2nd anniversary, this awakened version of Motoha is an extremely strong unit. **Although she is an Elec single-target dealer, she has a unique structure that targets 2 enemies at once.** She is a HIGHLIGHT-centered dealer, but unlike most characters, she does not consume HIGHLIGHT gauge and does not have a separate cooldown. (Her HIGHLIGHT even has its own actual skill name.) To trigger HIGHLIGHT, she needs a combined total of 3 stacks of [Light]/[Shadow], and she can hold up to 6 stacks, allowing two consecutive activations. Only [Light] directly affects her damage, so building as many [Light] stacks as possible is the main goal. These stacks are gained at turn start and when using Skill 1. At Awareness 1 or higher, Skill 3 also grants 1 stack, so her cycle changes. **Skill 2 only triggers the damage portion of Skill 1 and does not apply the debuff from Skill 1, so it is generally not used unless you specifically need the Taunt.**
Because HIGHLIGHT contributes such a large share of her total damage, Ayaka is effectively treated as a mandatory teammate. The simultaneously released 4★ thief Aran also applies debuffs while naturally targeting 2 enemies, which is why he is rated highly as a teammate despite being a 4★ unit. Since Manaka's turn revert does not restore these stacks, testing shifted toward using her with Fuuka. Although Motoha seems designed around a 2-turn base cycle, considering that Fuuka A0 can only swap twice, the more recommended pattern is to save HIGHLIGHT for turns 3 and 6.

upcoming.name: Aran Hirano
upcoming.review:

Skill 1 stacks [Sinful Karma] on enemies marked with [Sin] and copies it to other enemies carrying [Sin], while Skill 2 functions as a unique defensive tool that turns the party's affinity into Repel.

As a result, she plays more like a hybrid support who simultaneously provides **Defense Down, increased HIGHLIGHT damage taken, Attack buffs, and reflect-based utility**.

She also pairs especially well with Radiance Motoha, who naturally targets 2 enemies and can make strong use of [Sin] propagation.

upcoming.name: Narumi Nashimoto
upcoming.review:
She is a P5X original character and a **Psy single-target dealer capable of gaining an additional turn** every 2 turns. Through **WONDER's support**, which has a 1-turn cooldown, Narumi can **gain an additional turn**. This enables an explosive playstyle where she can unleash all three of her skills in a 1-2-3 sequence within just 2 turns. To maximize Skill 3, she needs 10 [Shiny Points] stacks. Her kit is designed so that this is achieved naturally as long as the player follows the correct skill rotation, requiring no extra setup.
While she **performs at full capacity even at Awareness 0**, her efficiency at Awareness 1 (granting WONDER an extra turn) and Awareness 2 (dramatically boosting Skill 3's power) makes her **breakthrough efficiency exceptional**. Since her HIGHLIGHT gauge and cooldown progress regardless of extra turns, she can **use HIGHLIGHT much more frequently** than other dealers, and her damage multipliers are impressively high. At Awareness 6, she gains yet another extra turn, pairing perfectly with ANGE for turn-reset tactics. In a full Awareness 6 party, it's possible to take up to 9 actions in a single turn. Because she has no independent multiplier bucket, pairing her with Katayama, who can provide one through Fuka and Down, is highly efficient. As a result, both Elucidator Thieves can be utilized effectively. From Awareness 2, the [Shiny Points] stack cap increases to 16. To reach this, WONDER's extra turn special skill [Attend My Handshake Event ❤︎] must be used before Skill 1.

upcoming.tagsKr: 적합성 저하, 화상, 감전, 동결, 방어력 감소, 지속 대미지
upcoming.review:
An original P3 character, Koromaru is a debuffer who **enhances Fire, Elec, and Ice weaknesses**. Using the same mechanism as Futaba, he changes enemy affinity so that **Resist (0.5x) becomes Normal (1.0x), Normal becomes Weak (1.2x), and Weak becomes Enhanced Weakness (1.45x).** Unless an enemy dies and a new one appears, the weakness enhancement effect can be **maintained throughout his cycle almost constantly**. He reduces Down Points by 2 on turn 1 and by 4 on turn 2, allowing him to force an enemy Down every 2 turns.
He has a unique system: after selecting one [Master], he acts during that [Master]'s turn and no longer has a separate personal turn. The three skills are identical except for which of Fire, Elec, or Ice damage taken they amplify, so in practice he is played by repeatedly using one skill that matches the ally's attribute.
He also has a passive that increases allies' Attack based on his Ailment Accuracy. Since there is no cap, **it is best to stack as much Ailment Accuracy as possible**. When Koromaru enters as Fuuka's Shift Member, that passive and Revelation set effects tied to "during battle" do not activate, so you effectively need to prepare at least two Revelation loadouts. Sets such as [Defeat] + [Freedom] or [Departure] + [Prosperity], which help fill out Ailment Accuracy, are also valid options, so it is recommended to choose based on the party setup.

upcoming.name: Aigis
upcoming.review:
A P3R collaboration **Gun-element Domination DPS**. Her kit looks complicated on paper, but in actual play she is one of the simplest damage dealers released so far.

**Using Skill 3 automatically triggers Theurgy and enters [Orgia Mode], after which all skills are used automatically until the end of her next turn. In other words, the player only needs to press Skill 3.**

To explain the flow more precisely: [Turn 1 uses Skill 3 to enter Orgia Mode → on Turn 2, Skill 1 and Skill 2 automatically activate as ally turns end to build stacks → at the end of Turn 2, the stacks are consumed and the enhanced Skill 3 activates automatically]. Skill 1 and Skill 2 are effectively the same skill.

Because Skill 1, 2, and 3 that activate automatically during [Orgia Mode] are all **treated as Theurgy skills**, she fully benefits from both Theurgy damage increases and Theurgy Damage Amp effects. For reference, from KR/CN 5.0 onward, exclusive weapons started receiving Damage Amp-type effects.

Her play pattern is already complete at Awareness 0.
At Awareness 1, one extra automatic Skill 1 is added, increasing cycle damage. Awareness 2 may look complicated because it mentions Theurgy Energy, but in practice it can be understood as an increase to the Skill 3 multiplier triggered when [Orgia Mode] ends.
From Awareness 6 onward, in a 6-turn battle, once Skill 3 is used, [Orgia Mode] no longer ends before the fight finishes, allowing her to keep attacking automatically until the battle ends.

upcoming.review:
A P5D collab character who can be **cycled between Strategist and Saboteur roles depending on the skill loop**. Skill 1 is an excellent buff that increases all allies' critical rate and critical damage, while Skill 2 applies a debuff that lowers enemy Defense and reduces Down Points. **Skill 3 triggers 『Coordinated Damage』, which pulls each highest damage-related stat from allies, while also launching 『Coordinated Strike』 based on Ren's own stats.**
Because Skill 3's 『Coordinated Damage』 multiplier is already very high from Awareness 0, he is effectively complete as a **sub-DPS**. On top of that, **『Coordinated Strike』** is an Almighty attack that is not affected by enemy Defense, still accounts for critical rate and critical damage, and benefits from All-Out Attack amplification, making it a **near-perfect damage skill that is strong enough for him to work as a standalone main DPS**. Even though multi-target attacks usually have lower skill multipliers, this one gains damage as the number of enemies decreases, up to double damage, so it can be used immediately against single-target fights as well.
Additionally, simply owning him **permanently increases All-Out Attack damage by a fixed amount even when he is not deployed**, so he improves Velvet Trial runs that actively rely on All-Out Attacks and also raises the damage of characters affected by All-Out Attack damage. His Awareness 1 and Awareness 2 gains are also far higher than those of previously released Phantom Thieves, making him an unusual case where choosing Awareness over buying his signature weapon is strongly recommended. --- 『Coordinated Strike』: Treated as All-Out Attack damage and benefits from the user's All-Out Attack damage bonus. This damage cannot critically hit, but converts critical rate and critical damage into final damage bonus. If there are fewer than 5 enemies, this damage increases by 25% for each missing enemy. 『Coordinated Damage』: Calculated using the highest Attack, highest damage bonus, highest critical rate, and highest critical damage among allies on the team other than the user. 『Phantom Form』: Grants immunity to mental ailments, control effects, and Down Point damage. However, if Ren Amamiya·Starlight is the only ally who can act, 『Phantom Form』 is removed.

After boost, additionally increase all allies' critical rate by 15.6%/17.2%/16.6%/18.2%. Increase the critical damage buff effect to 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7% (based on Ren's critical damage, up to 78.1%/86.1%/82.9%/90.9% bonus critical damage at 197.6%/207.6%/203.6%/213.6% critical damage).

upcoming.review:
A P5D collab character and the first debuffer who can fully reduce enemy Defense by himself.

The weakness of previous Saboteur characters was that enemy debuffs disappeared when enemies died and were resummoned, or when enemies were replaced. This time, however, **the debuff skills have been changed into permanent effects**.

Morgana·Starlight uses 『Wind Exhaustion』, an elemental ailment that functions as an upgraded version of Wind Assault, and **when it successfully reaches 10 stacks, it can reduce the enemy's total Defense by 100%**.

- If there is a Wind ally in the party, A0/A1 reach 100% Defense reduction starting from turn 3/2, respectively.

- If there is no Wind ally in the party, then in a normal cycle, A0/A1 reach 100% Defense reduction starting from turn 4/2, respectively, and then on every even-numbered turn.

For Wind damage only, excess Pierce and Defense reduction are converted into damage bonus through his passive (with a cap), so the kit is designed so that characters who already have Pierce do not lose much value.

He performs well enough as a flexible option even in parties of other elements, but reaches overwhelming performance when placed in a Wind party.

---

**Because Skills 1 and 2 are permanent effects, use Skills 1 and 2 first. Afterwards, keep using Skill 3 to enter Cat Car mode and deal Physical damage** to enemies.

Since this is Physical damage, a critical hit reduces Down Points by 1. On top of that, when a critical hit occurs, it additionally reduces Down Points by 6, effectively causing a **guaranteed knockdown**.

His passive doubles Critical Rate, so raising Critical Rate to 50% in battle is enough.

---

Wind Exhaustion: Lowers total Defense by 10%. Lasts 1 turn, stacks up to 10 times, and is treated as a Wind Assault effect.

Rhapsodic Beat: A combat resource shared by Starlight characters. Starlight characters can spend this resource to boost their skills. At the start of a Starlight character's turn, restore 1 Rhapsodic Beat, up to a maximum of 8.

upcoming.name: Ann Takamaki · Starlight
upcoming.review:
The third P5D collab character, and a single-target Fire DPS who combines several skills into one Persona skill.

SP is basically used as the gauge for her skill combo, and her Max SP is increased to 300. Outside of the 100 SP restored each turn by her Awareness effect (125 at A1+), she cannot restore SP.

**Her basic play pattern is to combine Skills 1 and 2 to build stacks, then spend those stacks to use Skill 3 heavily in one turn.** Each skill has its own SP cost and stack gain or consumption.

- Skill 1: 25 SP / +1 stack
- Skill 2: 50 SP / +2 stacks
- Skill 3: 50 SP / -4 stacks

> Example: Skill 2 + Skill 1 + Skill 1 = spends 100 SP, gains 4 stacks

Skill 1 grants a damage bonus that lasts 3 turns and stacks up to 6 times, while Skill 2 enhances the next two skills used afterward.

Because she needs to be piloted with this structure in mind to reach her highest damage, her execution difficulty is high. However, **because her sequence can be built freely, she is not locked into a fixed cycle like more typical DPS characters**.
